content: {"episode_id":"ep-05057","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"We appeal the CO-197 denial of CPT 93229, Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring, for this patient. The clinical indication note documents recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness consistent with supraventricular tachycardia (I47.1), occurring against a background of known atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary artery (I25.10). Mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to capture intermittent arrhythmic events and correlate symptoms with rhythm disturbances in an outpatient setting. Authorization status is recorded as missing, and we request review of medical necessity based on this documented indication."}
